response.justification: While Bogdan possesses over 15 years of robust software engineering experience and a strong entrepreneurial background, his profile aligns more with a Staff Full-Stack Engineer than a Director-level Principal AI Strategist. He lacks the deep, recognized expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and enterprise-level strategic cloud advising required for this highly specialized leadership role.
strengths: Over 15 years of comprehensive software engineering experience across diverse technology stacks.
Demonstrated entrepreneurial drive as the founder of an open-source Geo-Data platform.
Recent hands-on experience building AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling.
concerns: Lacks the required Director-level seniority and enterprise-wide strategic leadership experience.
AI expertise is relatively nascent and lacks the depth of a recognized industry AI expert.
No demonstrated experience advising strategic enterprise customers on cloud and AI adoption.
